recommended_path: NGO registration with the National Secretariat for Non-Governmental Organizations (mandated by Act No. 31 of 1980 s.3 + Presidential Circular RAD/99/01 of 06.02.1999) — mandatory for both domestic and foreign NGOs; the Companies Act No. 07 of 2007 CLG route is barred for INGOs
entity_types: NGO registered with the National Secretariat (domestic and foreign; INGOs must register here even if incorporated elsewhere)
CLG / private trust via eROC — NOT available to international NGOs (barred); domestic-only alternate route

requirements.founders: Board of directors before registration: at least 5 officers; at most 2 officers may be of the same family (spouse/children/parents/siblings); for local organizations a majority of officers must be Sri Lankan citizens (page text cut off mid-sentence — treat as verified for local orgs, unverified detail for INGOs). Pre-qualifications: voluntary, non-profit, no profit-sharing, funds may come from public or foreign donations, no personal/political/religious aims, constitutional legality, relief or social-service aim
requirements.local_presence: Communication address in Sri Lanka and demonstrated financial capacity required; no separate local-agent requirement stated on the ngosec page
requirements.documents: Proposed name + board of directors details before registration; communication address; financial capacity evidence; (full document list not visible on ngosec page — middle-pruned)

forms: National Secretariat NGO registration application (14th Floor Suhurupaya, Battaramulla; +94 11 287 7376; info@ngosec.gov.lk / ngosecretariat.gov@gmail.com)

fees.amount: unverified — fee not visible on the ngosec.gov.lk page (middle-pruned); no official figure confirmed this round
fees.note: Prior dataset figure 'LKR 5,000-20,000' is unverified — do not assert.

fees.item: CLG/eROC incorporation fees (domestic alternate route only)
fees.amount: Rs. 45,000 (one secretary) + Rs. 2,300 per additional director/secretary — government filing fees only
fees.note: Third-party figure; covers gov filing fees only, excludes lawyer/notary. Route is unavailable to international NGOs in any case.

timelines.secretariat_registration: unverified — prior dataset figure '2-6 weeks' not confirmed this round

supersedes: Prior enrich-task claim 'easy, low fees (~LKR 5,000-20,000), 2-6 weeks' — fee and timeline both unverified against primary sources; downgraded.

Prior claim 'no citizenship requirement for trustees' — contradicted for local organizations: the Secretariat requires a MAJORITY of Sri Lankan citizen officers for local orgs (ngosec.gov.lk). For INGOs the board rules apply but the local-citizen majority text is cut off; record as unverified for INGOs, verified for local orgs.
notes: Existing CLGs must ALSO register with the Secretariat if they operate as NGOs
12B tax-exempt certificate application to the IRD is a separate post-registration step

CLG route details (if domestic-only): eROC incorporation s.32 — ≥2 members, ≥2 directors, 1 registered company secretary; Forms 05/18/19 + Articles; name reservation valid 3 months (counselit.com, third-party)
